extracted.intended_audience: Researchers applying for the EMBO Long-term Fellowship (postdoctoral applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and mandatory requirements for preparing and submitting an EMBO Long-term Fellowship application, covering proposal structure, referees, publications, and administrative obligations. Intended to ensure applications meet format, content, and submission rules used by the Fellowship Committee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application language
rubrics_metrics.description: All applications must be in English.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of referees required
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure that 2 references are submitted online before the deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You are responsible to ensure that 2 references ... are submitted online before the deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Receiving institute acceptance submission
rubrics_metrics.description: The receiving institute acceptance must be submitted online before the deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You are responsible to ensure that ... the receiving institute acceptance are submitted online before the deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Referee composition – PhD supervisor
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the referees should be your PhD supervisor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Referee conflict of interest – no referees from receiving institute
rubrics_metrics.description: None of the referees can be from the receiving institute.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorship of research proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: The research proposal should be written by the applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The proposal must be the applicant's own writing (not written by others).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research proposal overall quality
rubrics_metrics.description: The research proposal should be detailed and well-argued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It should be sufficiently detailed to allow the Fellowship Committee members to form a clear idea of the planned work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research proposal required components and lengths
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a 200-word summary followed by a 200-word explanation outlining the biological significance; the detailed research proposal should not exceed 1500 words (excluding references); a brief introduction should outline background.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structure: 200-word summary + 200-word biological significance explanation; detailed proposal ≤1500 words (references excluded); include a brief introduction to outline background to the proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Level of detail for committee assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: The research proposal should be sufficiently detailed to allow the Fellowship Committee members to form a clear idea of the planned work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide enough experimental/approach detail (within the word-limit) so reviewers can assess feasibility and scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Figures and tables prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: Figures or tables cannot be included in the application materials (research proposal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not attempt to include images, graphical abstracts, or tables as part of the proposal text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference formatting in research proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: References in the research proposal should include the complete list of AUTHORS followed by the YEAR, TITLE of the paper, JOURNAL, and details on volume, page numbers etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use full author lists and full citation details rather than abbreviated or citation-only formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Synopsis of work performed at home institute
rubrics_metrics.description: The synopsis should allow the reader to appreciate both your past experience and its relevance, if any, to the proposed research topic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generally this section will refer to your PhD work; emphasize past experience and relevance to proposed project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Achievements of PhD section
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide your own summary of what you consider the most important outcome(s) of your PhD work and the impact of your work on and beyond the respective scientific field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on key outcomes and broader impact; this is a personal summary of significance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication list – exclude unpublished works and abstracts
rubrics_metrics.description: The list of publications by the applicant should not include papers submitted or in preparation. Details of abstracts of presentations at conferences should not be included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only include published work; do not list conference abstracts or manuscripts not yet published.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication list – identify three most important papers and metrics guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate your three most important publications — the three primary research papers that in your view provided the most important and original contributions to scientific knowledge irrespective of journal name and impact factor. Do NOT add the journal impact factor. Citations to the article or other article level metrics with source may be listed, but are not essential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select three key papers and rank/identify them; avoid including journal impact factors; if citing metrics, provide source for those metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Order for shared first authorship
rubrics_metrics.description: In the case of shared first authorship please keep the order of authors as they appear on the original publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: No publication updates after deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication updates after the application deadline are not accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not attempt to add or notify about new publications after submission deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligation to notify change of contact details
rubrics_metrics.description: If your contact details/address change after submission the Fellowship Office must be informed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notify the Fellowship Office promptly of any post-submission contact detail changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants are responsible for ensuring required elements (references, institute acceptance) are submitted online by the deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Double-check that referees and receiving institute have completed their parts before the deadline; late or missing items are the applicant's responsibility.
